notes.title: Small Update 1/23/22
notes.notes:
Substepped Physics.
-This is a pretty big change that will affect all of the physics in the game. before physics were adjusted for delta time, but 30 big forces will have a different effect to 120 small forces, resulting in substantially different disc flights at different framerates. now the physics is separated from the framerate, resulting in smoother flight for the majority of players
-The big effect is now everyone will see the same result for each throw, whether at 30 or 144 fps

General Changes
-swapped over to new logo + new flag on the baskets
-reduced nose down on putts, resulting in flatter flights
-some changes to make tap ins more reliable

Woohoo! cant wait for yall to try it, disc flight looks better than ever. this will also give me a good base to make further changes to the physics, with more predictable results along a range of conditions

Rob

notes.title: Local Multiplayer! Major Patch 3
notes.notes:
Woohoo, local multiplayer is done! I had to rework a lot of the game to account for multiple players, but it was worth it. You can blame Trackmania and Monster Train for some of the delay. 

The play menu is now changed, and lets you select wind speed in addition to time of day. Character selection has been moved to a second screen, where local players can join in. The Range can also be played multiplayer to see who can get the furthest drive.

Player skill level can also be selected per player with this change, allowing you to test out higher powered rounds or handicapping a player in local multiplayer.  Gold/Records are only earned when playing on the current skill level however.

Discs also got a big visual upgrade, and look sweet. The new colors randomly generated are now bright and awesome instead of mostly pastel colors.
https://gfycat.com/disgustingvibrantantelope



-had to rewrite a lot of the components in the game to account for multiple players, some should contribute to performance improvements
-wind can now be selected for local multiplayer and single player rounds
-player can set their skill level when starting the game. gold is only earned when playing on the save file skill level, but multiple players can earn gold when playing local multiplayer

-Use (on controller) the face buttons and prev/next disc to razz your opponents while they throw. or equivalent keys on the keyboard
-re-did the models and lighting on discs, and changed the way random colors are generated for more attractive random colors
-some discs have real stamps, for the ones that do 90% will be real stamps and 1 in 10 a special stamp

I see some small changes I want to make in the near future, including fixing any bugs that may arise with the multiplayer. The next big update will be once my Motion Capture suit arrives! I am also going to dig into the entire animation setup and make lots of improvements.

notes.title: Major Patch 1: The Wind Update
notes.notes:
Along with wind being implemented in the game, the first big patch for Perfect Round Disc Golf features 2 new 18 hole courses!

The wind is fully simulated during disc flight, looking at difference in Air Speed, affecting turn and glide, and the angle the wind is hitting the flight plate. It adds up to the wind reacting how you would expect.  Flags have been added to the baskets which will show the wind, and trees and bushes will react realistically.

Long Layouts have been added to Green Hills and Rolling Thunder, bringing the total course count to 7! Unlock them by shooting par or better on the respective course short layout. Because some of the existing holes were split between the long and short layouts, current high scores had to be reset for those two courses. 

I'm super pleased with the progress the game has made in the first month and a half of Early Access, and it is thanks to all the feedback I'm getting from players like you! Thank you everyone for your patience and feedback in this process, I love to be able to work on a Disc Golf game with feedback from the community. If you're not already part of the discord server, sign up here to post suggestions and for the latest updates:

https://discord.gg/cH2w8n

List of key additions since launch:
-Driving Range
-Ability to lean left/right on any shot, allowing for straddle putts and step outs
-New Character: Morigesh
-Wind
-2 new courses
-improved disc flight and physics
-Endless bug fixes and user experience improvements.

Thanks!
Rob

notes.title: Weekly Patch Notes #4
notes.notes:
Made some big(and important) changes to the discs flight/release this week. This should address the complaints about discs not flying on the intended line, as they no longer get a vertical boost on release in relation to the flight plate. That caused steep hyzers for example to get pushed left(for a right handed character) on release, now they look WAY better and more of a sweeping flight.

It was also brought to my attention the third click wasn't registering properly, which was completely true and an oversight on my part. I rewrote the check so it is now pixel perfect, and changed the sound to make it more obvious when you hit the yellow "perfect" zone. If you hit the yellow, even if you are not exactly centered, there will be no hyzer/anhyzer penalty.

I also changed the punishment for a missed third click, before it would just penalize the hyzer angle left/right depending on the missed click, now that penalty is reduced but it also pushes the disc left/right. This feels way more natural and enables griplock anhyzers and slip out hyzers. 

Lastly I added the first new character! Morigesh is a lefty, to balance the lefty/righty characters. Definitely the most evil of disc golfers. Now that there are four characters future characters will have to be unlocked in some way.

Instead, they are just angled up 10-20 degrees straight vertically. this was the cause of throws not appearing to fly down the line you were aiming, which would have been worse on steep hyzers/anhyzers as they would get a boost left/right. The releases look a million times better
-also helps with short putts releasing low, will not have to aim as far above the basket

Thanks!
Rob
